messages.subject: extracting mean methylation between groups
parts:
I used calculateDiffMeth to get the table of differentially methylated CpGs.

Is there a way to extract the  weighted.mean methylation between groups that is calculated for each CpG site ?

Thank you
Linda

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] extracting mean methylation between groups
parts:
no, but you should be able to calculate it, in a couple lines of R code. weighted mean is simply sum off all numCs in a group dived by sum of coverage in a group. If you search the discussion group, someone may have asked for such a thing already and maybe there is code associated with the answer. 

Best,
Altuna
